clockAndBudgetModel.relativeClockFormula: snapshotElapsedSeconds = (context.gameTotalMinutes - 735) * 0.5; a recorded observation verifies this conversion.
clockAndBudgetModel.releaseFormula: Each actual dispatch start consumes one slot until the first scheduler Tick with tick >= start + 60. Cancellation and correction do not refund a start.
clockAndBudgetModel.requestBudgetDistinction: context.remainingCalls is the current decision continuation budget; it is not the rolling-world budget. Proxy and per-trial caps are also separate.
clockAndBudgetModel.utcLimitation: Old evidence has no provider-start file and no call start UTC. Trial UTC precedes loading. New provider UTC timestamps identify provider recorder starts, not exact Unity scheduler enqueue instants.
clockAndBudgetModel.continuationTimeLimitation: Step 2 preserves step 1 gameTotalMinutes; it must not be treated as a second start at the same game minute.

oldAtCancellation.cancelClockCaveat: Approximation adds client Stopwatch duration to context-derived tick time; serialization, in-frame time and main-thread scheduling are not recorded. The approximate result is compatible with crossing 795, but is not an observed cancellation game timestamp.

conditionalPendingExpiry.condition: If Ren ScheduleChanged around game minute 795 generated a Pending snapshot at that time, and no later event replaced it. This Pending was not logged.
conditionalPendingExpiry.interpretation: The assumed Pending would expire before capacity returns; the meeting itself would still be valid for about 37.5 real seconds after capacity returns. Absence of a ninth call is recorded; Pending expiry as its cause remains unconfirmed.

movingAtCancellation.interpretation: The eighth call had one unused rolling-window slot. This control shows new-event recovery after stale cancellation, not recovery after a saturated rolling window.

findings.statement: Old trial corrected an injected first invitation omission using step 2; all 8 proxy records and all 8 provider contents map to its 8 recorded calls. Last provider candidate passed but the Unity client recorded cancellation and no operation. No ninth call is recorded.

Old state changes show three accepted transcript lines, a delivered receipt, then Expired at game 930.0000376 and work-route recovery at 1000. No Pending, queue-depth, event-delivery or per-frame revision trace was recorded after the final request.

Old default window was full after the eighth dispatch; first release is around elapsed 60 seconds / game 855. A hypothetical Pending made at 795 would hit the 30-game-minute lifetime near 825, before that release. The historical evidence alone cannot confirm the creation, replacement or disposal of that Pending.

Moving F call 7 was cancelled with agent.decision_stale; call 8 used a new decision ID, revision 11 instead of 10, ScheduleChanged at 795.0025594, step 1 and empty candidate feedback. Its response executed as the fourth transcript line; host turn limit completed the meeting.

Both trials recorded 8 total calls, but old failure spent an extra call on injected invitation correction and therefore cancelled at the eighth occupied slot; moving cancelled at slot 7 and used the remaining slot to recover. Different frozen sources, prompts, observation inputs, trial dates and model samples prevent a causal fix-rate claim.

uncertainties: Old schedule-event delivery at 795 and resulting Pending cannot be observed directly from the retained file. The source-authored schedule and short cancellation duration support the hypothesis only.
No exact absolute scheduler start UTC or queue timestamp is recorded in either trial. Converted context times represent snapshot creation; delayed dispatch would shift the relevant release later.
Per-frame observations were intentionally omitted unless meeting state, receipt or transcript count changed. The long recorded gap does not prove the scheduler stopped ticking.
Recovery at 1000 is an explicit fixture advance after model dispatch stops, not evidence of further autonomous decisions.
The moving control does not exhaust all 8 starts before needing its successor; it cannot validate saturated-budget recovery.
